title: Moje tempo też jest tempem
sunoPrompt: Angular fast alternative rock, 144 BPM, dry break-like live drums, abrasive rhythmic guitar and a forceful bass pocket. Taut verses and a repeated percussive sung chorus. Gritty, energetic, human and physically propulsive. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
